1	/****************************************************************************
2	 * arch/arm/include/bk7258/irq.h
3	 *
4	 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
5	 *
6	 * Stage A1 IRQ definitions for the Beken BK7258 (Cortex-M33).
7	 *
8	 * The vector table in bk7258_vectors.c has 80 entries:
9	 *
10	 *   [0]      initial MSP                       (offset 0x000)
11	 *   [1]      __start                           (offset 0x004)
12	 *   [2..15]  14 system exception slots         (offset 0x008 .. 0x03c)
13	 *   [16..63] 48 lower external IRQ slots       (offset 0x040 .. 0x0fc)
14	 *   [64..65] BK7236 app magic "BK7236\0\0"     (offset 0x100 .. 0x104)
15	 *   [66..79] 16 upper external IRQ slots       (offset 0x108 .. 0x13c)
16	 *
17	 * NR_IRQS = 80 makes ARMV8M_PERIPHERAL_INTERRUPTS = 64, so the standard
18	 * NuttX vector layout expects exactly slots [16..79] for IRQs.  The two
19	 * app-magic words at [64]/[65] occupy logical IRQ numbers 48 and 49 and
20	 * are runtime-repaired via arm_ramvec_attach after VTOR switches to RAM.
21	 * This is exactly the layout the T5-AI Tier-1 bootloader
22	 * validates (see docs/bk7258-t5ai/probe/probe.c).
23	 *
24	 * A1 enables interrupts; the common ARMv8-M code needs the NVIC priority
25	 * macros below at compile time, so they are defined here.
26	 * This header is reached via <arch/chip/irq.h> which <arch/irq.h> includes
27	 * BEFORE <arch/arm_m/irq.h> (and hence before nuttx/include/arch/arm_m/
28	 * nvicpri.h), so the priority values are visible when nvicpri.h derives
29	 * NVIC_SYSH_{MAXNORMAL,HIGH,DISABLE,SVCALL}_PRIORITY from them.
30	 ****************************************************************************/
31	
32	#ifndef __ARCH_ARM_INCLUDE_BK7258_IRQ_H
33	#define __ARCH_ARM_INCLUDE_BK7258_IRQ_H
34	
35	/****************************************************************************
36	 * Included Files
37	 ****************************************************************************/
38	
39	#include <nuttx/config.h>
40	
41	/****************************************************************************
42	 * Pre-processor Definitions
43	 ****************************************************************************/
44	
45	/* 64 external interrupts -> vector slots [16..79]; magic at [64]/[65].
46	 * Slots [64]/[65] correspond to external IRQ indices 48/49 but are logical
47	 * NuttX IRQs 64/65 (ETHERNET/SCALE0).  They hold boot magic in flash and
48	 * are runtime-repaired to exception_common after VTOR switches to RAM.
49	 */
50	
51	#define BK7258_IRQ_FIRST                16
52	#define BK7258_EXTERNAL_IRQS            64
53	#define NR_IRQS                         (BK7258_IRQ_FIRST + BK7258_EXTERNAL_IRQS)
54	
55	/* Cortex-M system exception vector numbers (offset by 16 from IRQ number).
56	 * Provided here so chip.h / board code can name them; mirror the values in
57	 * nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/nvic.h.
58	 */
59	
60	#define BK7258_IRQ_NMI                  (2)
61	#define BK7258_IRQ_HARDFAULT            (3)
62	#define BK7258_IRQ_SVCALL               (11)
63	#define BK7258_IRQ_PENDSV               (14)
64	#define BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK              (15)
65	
66	/* UART1 peripheral sits at chip IRQ 15, which maps to NuttX vector slot
67	 * [16 + 15] = [31].  The slot is already wired to exception_common in
68	 * bk7258_vectors.c, so the vector table itself needs no change.
69	 */
70	
71	#define BK7258_IRQ_UART1                (BK7258_IRQ_FIRST + 15) /* logical 31 */
72	
73	/* Anchor IRQ names for the upper external range.  These logical IRQ
74	 * numbers occupy vector slots [64]/[65] which are also the boot-magic
75	 * slots; runtime repair via arm_ramvec_attach restores exception_common
76	 * after VTOR switches to RAM.
77	 */
78	
79	#define BK7258_IRQ_ETHERNET             (BK7258_IRQ_FIRST + 48) /* logical 64 */
80	#define BK7258_IRQ_SCALE0               (BK7258_IRQ_FIRST + 49) /* logical 65 */
81	#define BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX              (BK7258_IRQ_FIRST + 63) /* logical 79 */
82	
83	/* NVIC priority encoding for the Cortex-M33 core.  The core implements
84	 * priority bits [7:5] (3 bits -> 8 priority levels, top 5 bits
85	 * implemented).  Values are identical to every other stock Cortex-M3/4/33
86	 * in NuttX (see nuttx/include/arch/mps/chip.h); the BK7258 does not add
87	 * anything special here.
88	 *
89	 *   MAX     = 0x00  (highest, exception entry uses this)
90	 *   DEFAULT = 0x80  (midpoint, used by up_irq_save/disable via BASEPRI)
91	 *   MIN     = 0xf0  (lowest)
92	 *   STEP    = 0x10  (16 between adjacent levels)
93	 */
94	
95	#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN          0xf0
96	#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT      0x80
97	#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MAX          0x00
98	#define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_STEP         0x10
99	
100	/****************************************************************************
101	 * CP and the board-verified AP-UP fallback remain independent UP kernels.
102	 * CONFIG_SMP is permitted only for the explicit N8-B1 AP bootstrap config.
103	 ****************************************************************************/
104	
105	#if defined(CONFIG_SMP) && \
106	    (!defined(CONFIG_BK7258_AP_CORE) || \
107	     !defined(CONFIG_BK7258_AP_SMP_BOOTSTRAP))
108	#  error "BK7258 SMP is permitted only for the N8-B1 AP bootstrap config"
109	#endif
110	
111	/****************************************************************************
112	 * Boot-magic structural constants (image byte offsets, not vector indices).
113	 *
114	 * The Tier-1 bootloader validates a 64-bit app magic "BK7236\0\0" at image
115	 * byte offsets 0x100 and 0x104.  These offsets are determined by the
116	 * original 48-external-IRQ layout: (16 system + 48 external) * 4 = 0x100.
117	 * They do NOT change when external IRQs expand from 48 to 64 in A1,
118	 * because the magic always occupies vector slots [64] and [65].
119	 ****************************************************************************/
120	
121	#define BK7258_MAGIC_BOOT0_OFFSET       0x100
122	#define BK7258_MAGIC_BOOT1_OFFSET       0x104
123	#define BK7258_MAGIC_BOOT_SIZE          8
124	
125	#endif /* __ARCH_ARM_INCLUDE_BK7258_IRQ_H */

45	### 2.3 关键判断（已实测）
46	
47	- **APB WDT vs AON WDT 在 SDK 是两套独立 API**：
48	  - `bk_wdt_*` → `wdt_ll` → `WDT_LL_REG_BASE` ≡ `SOC_WDT_REG_BASE = 0x44800000`（APB），与 `hal->id` 无关
49	  - `bk_aon_wdt_*` → `aon_wdt_ll` → `SOC_AON_WDT_REG_BASE = 0x44000600`（AON）
50	  - `wdt_hal.c` 里混写两个基址的代码全在 `BK7236XX/7239XX/7286XX` 守卫内，BK7258 编译掉
51	- **CP 路径 = `$BK_AVDK/cp/middleware/`**：我们引入的源码一律取 `cp/`，不碰 `ap/`
52	- **共享资源**：跨核共享的外设（如 flash、TRNG）需确认 CP 侧可用且不与 AP 抢；WDT/APB/AON
53	  是 CP 基础外设，CPU0 可用

## 1. Core conclusion

For BK7258 AP SMP, the reusable official NuttX contract is:

- `up_cpu_start(cpu)` starts logical CPUs `1..CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1`.
- `up_cpu_idlestack(cpu, tcb, stack_size)` must provision logical CPU1’s IDLE stack before `up_cpu_start()`.
- `up_send_smp_sched(cpu)` is the architecture IPI hook used by the scheduler to make a target CPU process `g_delivertasks`.
- `up_send_smp_call(cpuset)` is the architecture IPI hook used by `nxsched_smp_call*()` after the software call queue is populated.
- The IPI IRQ handler must run in IRQ context, use logical `this_cpu()`, and eventually call:
  - `nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg)` for SMP-call work.
  - `nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu())` for scheduler-delivery work.
- On BK7258 AP, logical CPU IDs must remain AP-local `0/1`, not SoC physical `1/2`, because NuttX indexes per-CPU arrays with the returned ID.
- Current BK7258 N8-B1 implementation intentionally has no working IPI: CPU2 reaches `SECONDARY_READY`, stays parked, and `up_send_smp_sched()`/`up_send_smp_call()` fail closed with `-ENOSYS`/`IPI_UNAVAILABLE`.

The safe N8-B2 direction is: implement a team-overlay-only AP-local CPU1<->CPU2 IPI primitive first, using existing mailbox/doorbell hardware knowledge, prove bidirectional IRQ wake and counters, then wire the official `up_send_smp_sched()`/`up_send_smp_call()` hooks only after raw IPI is stable. Do not touch official NuttX files.

## 7. Ack/clear and ordering rules

### Verified BK raw doorbell order

Existing team raw CP/AP doorbell code uses:

Receiver:

1. Check READY bit.
2. Read PARAMs.
3. ACK:
   - write CLEAR bit.
   - `dsb sy`.
   - write READY = 0.
   - write CLEAR = 0.
   - `dsb sy`.

Sender:

1. If prior READY is still set, ACK/clear it first.
2. Write sender/receiver and PARAMs.
3. `dmb sy`.
4. Write READY bit.
5. `dsb sy; sev`.

- CP side: `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/cp/bk7258_ap_control.c`, lines 66-110.

### Official NuttX IPI ordering

- NuttX queues SMP-call data before calling `up_send_smp_call()`: `/home/lijian/project/open-vela/nuttx/sched/sched/sched_smp.c`, lines 473-485.
- Official mailbox-style handlers generally drain/process software call data, clear hardware cause, then process delivered tasks:
  - LC823450: lines 71-86.
  - SAM4CM: lines 73-90.
  - RP2040: lines 97-126.

### Recommended BK7258 B2 safe ordering

For BK7258’s raw mailbox/ready semantics, safest B2 handler order is:

1. IRQ entry.
2. Snapshot and drain all hardware mailbox/FIFO causes.
3. Read payload/reason/sequence.
4. Clear/ACK the hardware latch immediately after snapshot.
5. Barrier.
6. Update shared diagnostic counters.
7. For final NuttX hook wiring only:
   - if CALL pending: call `nxsched_smp_call_handler(irq, context, arg)`.
   - if SCHED pending: call `nxsched_process_delivered(this_cpu())`.

Reason: clearing after long software callback risks clearing a later edge if the mailbox READY bit is level-like. Use per-direction sequence counters to detect lost/duplicate events.

# BK7258 N8-B2 — AP logical CPU0 ↔ logical CPU1 bidirectional IPI

日期：2026-07-29

状态：`static-only`（实现进行中；尚未由用户编译、下载或板测）

分支：`feat/bk7258-ap-smp`

## 1. 本 Stage 边界

N8-B2 从已板测的 N8-B1 继续：

```text
physical CPU1 -> AP logical CPU0 -> NuttX SMP primary
physical CPU2 -> AP logical CPU1 -> NuttX-aware secondary bootstrap
```

本 Stage 只建立并验证 AP 内部 logical CPU0 ↔ logical CPU1 的双向 IPI 传输和 IRQ/WFI 唤醒：

- logical CPU0 / physical CPU1 向 logical CPU1 / physical CPU2 发送 IPI；
- logical CPU1 / physical CPU2 在 mailbox IRQ 中接收，并向 logical CPU0 回送 IPI；
- 两个方向各至少 100 次；
- 发送、接收和 sequence 必须闭合，pending、duplicate、lost、send failure 均为 0；
- CPU2 必须由 WFI 被 mailbox IRQ 唤醒；
- CPU2 仍停留在 `SECONDARY_READY`，`online_mask` 仍为 `0x1`。

本 Stage 仍不调用 CPU2 `nx_idle_trampoline()`，不让普通 task 在 logical CPU1 运行，不做
scheduler delivery、SMP call、affinity/migration/spinlock 压力，也不加入 RPTUN/RPMsg、Wi-Fi 或 BLE。

## 2. 架构约束：沿用 SDK wrapper

继续遵守 N6 确立的分层：

```text
NuttX SMP/诊断控制
        ↓
team-owned BK7258 thin wrapper
        ↓
Beken SDK mailbox / cross-core API
        ↓
BK7258 MBOX0 FIFO + source-63 mailbox IRQ
```

N8-B2 不在新 IPI wrapper 中直接编程 mailbox 寄存器。硬件发送、FIFO drain、ack 和 cross-core
消息分发继续使用 AP SDK 已有实现：

- `bk_mailbox_cc_init()`；
- `bk_mailbox_cc_init_on_current_core()`；
- `bk_mailbox_master_send()`；
- SDK `mbox0_drv_isr_handler()`；
- SDK 回调入口 `crosscore_mb_rx_isr()`。

SDK 的 `bk_int_isr_register(INT_SRC_MAILBOX, ...)` 由 team-owned SDK-to-NuttX IRQ bridge 接管，
映射到 NuttX `BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX` / IRQ 79。CPU2 vector 只把 mailbox slot 79 接入
`exception_common`；其他异常和外设 IRQ 继续 fail-closed 到 CPU2 fault handler。

## 3. 诊断协议

在 shared SRAM offset `0x200` 新增独立的 0x80-byte IPI state，不扩展或破坏：

- AP boot state `0x000..0x07f`；
- AP fault state `0x080..`；
- CP fault state `0x100..`；
- CPU2 N8-A/N8-B1 state `0x180..0x1ff`。

IPI command 使用 SDK cross-core zero-length message 的 32-bit command word，编码：

```text
31..24  magic 0xB2
23..20  type: PING / PONG / WAKE
19..12  AP generation low 8 bits
11..0   sequence 0..4095
```

测试采用单 outstanding ping-pong：logical CPU0 发送 `PING(n)`，logical CPU1 IRQ 收到后立即
回送 `PONG(n)`；logical CPU0 收到对应 PONG 后才发送下一序号。这避免以队列深度或并发 flood
掩盖丢包，并让两个方向都得到精确计数。

共享诊断至少记录：

- 两方向 tx/rx；
- last tx/rx sequence；
- duplicate/lost/send failure；
- 两个 logical CPU 的 IRQ count 和 WFI wake count；
- requested/completed count、test runs、last command；
- stale/spurious command 和最后 error。

## 4. 生命周期边界

- AP primary 在 `up_cpu_start(1)` 释放 CPU2 前初始化 IPI wrapper、SDK mailbox 和 NuttX IRQ bridge。
- CPU2 完成 N8-B1 的 ID/VTOR/MSP/IDLE-stack 验证后，只初始化本核 mailbox IRQ，随后
  `cpsie i` 并在 `WFI` 中 park。
- `apctl stop/restart/cycle` 请求 CPU2 停止时，logical CPU0 发送独立 `WAKE` IPI，使 CPU2 从
  WFI 返回并处理既有 STOP command；超时仍由既有 reset-hold 路径收口。
- AP-UP `configs/ap_up/` 和 N8-A freestanding probe 不修改。

## 5. 手动入口

CP 侧新增：

```text
apctl ipitest [count] [timeout_ms]
```

默认 count 为 100。命令继续通过既有 CP→AP control wrapper 和 boot-state/raw lifecycle doorbell
发起；AP 内部 IPI 数据面则只走 SDK mailbox wrapper。

`apctl status` 新增三行 IPI 证据：

```text
AP IPI state=... error=... generation=... requested=... completed=... runs=...
IPI 0->1 tx/rx/pending=.../.../... seq=.../... dup/lost/fail=.../.../...
IPI 1->0 tx/rx/pending=.../.../... seq=.../... dup/lost/fail=.../.../...
IPI irq/wake cpu0=.../... cpu1=.../... stale/spurious=.../...
```

## 6. 本轮执行边界

按用户要求：

- 由 Claude 修改 team overlay 代码和文档；
- 由用户负责编译、下载和真实板卡验证；
- 本轮不执行 Git 操作；
- 本轮不执行 Git/static verifier 等静态验收；
- 以板端实测为主，LittleFS 不纳入 factory image 的本 Stage 门禁。

## 7. 预期板测门禁

首次下载后：

```text
apctl status
apctl ipitest 100 3000
apctl status
```

必须满足：

```text
AP state=READY error=0
CPU2 state=SECONDARY_READY error=0
CPU2 ready=1 online=00000001 calls=0
IPI state=PASSED error=0 requested=100 completed=100
0->1 tx=100 rx=100 pending=0 duplicate=0 lost=0 fail=0
1->0 tx=100 rx=100 pending=0 duplicate=0 lost=0 fail=0
CPU2 irq >= 100
CPU2 WFI wake >= 100
无 CPU0/CPU2 HardFault、NMI 或 WDT restart
```

随后执行生命周期回归：

```text
apctl restart 3000
apctl ipitest 100 3000
apctl stop 3000
apctl start 3000
apctl ipitest 100 3000
apctl cycle 3 3000
apctl start 3000
apctl ipitest 100 3000
apctl status
```

每个新 generation 的 IPI state 必须重新初始化，三次测试均独立闭合；最终 AP 保持 READY。

## 8. 当前进展

- N8-B1 板端证据已完整闭环；
- SDK mailbox public API、AP SMP cross-core source、FIFO/channel 路由、source-63 IRQ 路径已重新核对；
- 已确定继续使用 SDK cross-core mailbox wrapper，而不是新增寄存器级 IPI 实现；
- 代码修改尚在进行；尚未编译、下载或板测。

### Wrapper 架构保持不变

IPI 数据面没有新增 mailbox 寄存器操作，路径为：

```text
NuttX / team wrapper
  -> Beken SDK bk_mailbox_cc_init()
  -> bk_mailbox_cc_init_on_current_core()
  -> bk_mailbox_master_send()
  -> SDK MBOX0 FIFO / source-63 IRQ
```

主要实现位于：

- `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/ap/bk7258_ap_ipi.c:1`
- `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/ap/bk7258_ap_smp.c:1`
- `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/include/bk7258_amp.h:1`

具体包括：

- 新增独立 `0x80` 字节 IPI shared state，位于 shared SRAM offset `0x200`，不改变 N8-B1 CPU2 ABI。
- AP logical CPU0/physical CPU1 ↔ logical CPU1/physical CPU2 双向 SDK cross-core mailbox。
- 复用现有 SDK-to-NuttX IRQ bridge，source 63 映射 NuttX IRQ 79。
- CPU2 vector 仅将 slot 79 接入 `exception_common`，其余 IRQ 继续 fail-closed。
- CPU2 开中断后进入 `WFI`，不进入 `nx_idle_trampoline()`。
- 单 outstanding `PING(n) → PONG(n)`，sequence 携带 generation，最多 4095 次。
- 记录两个方向的：
  - tx/rx/pending
  - last sequence
  - duplicate/lost/send failure
  - IRQ/wake count
  - stale/spurious
- 每轮 PING/PONG 后还等待 CPU2 heartbeat 前进，证明 CPU2 已从 WFI 返回。
- stop 路径通过独立 `WAKE` IPI 唤醒 CPU2，再执行原 STOP/reset-hold 收口。
- 新增：

```text
apctl ipitest [count] [timeout_ms]
```

控制和输出涉及：

- `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/cp/bk7258_ap_control.c:1`
- `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/app/hello_app/bk7258_apctl_main.c:1`

## 1. `exception_common` 编译错误

根因是 `exception_common` 是 common ARM 汇编异常入口，但 `arm_internal.h` 没有为当前 C 文件提供声明。

既有 AP 主 vector 文件采用的是：

```c
extern void exception_common(void);
```

已在 CPU2 vector 所在文件加入完全相同的声明：

- `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/ap/bk7258_ap_smp.c:63`

本次只补 prototype：

- 不改变 vector slot 79
- 不改变 handler 地址
- 不改变 IRQ 流程
- 不触碰 NuttX 官方树

## 2. 关于 AP/CP 共用 SDK IRQ bridge

你的疑问是对的。之前的状态是：

```text
chip/cp/bk7258_sdk_irq.c
```

它最初只为 N6 CPU0 SDK IRQ bridge 开发，所以历史上放在 `cp/`。N8-B2 为了最小修改，AP-SMP 直接从 `cp/` 路径复用了它。功能上可以工作，但随着 AP 也成为正式使用者，目录职责已经不准确。

现在已经调整为：

```text
chip/common/bk7258_sdk_irq.c
```

新位置：

- `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/common/bk7258_sdk_irq.c:1`

### 为什么移到 `common/`，而不是拆成 AP/CP 两份

bridge 的核心职责在两边完全一致：

```text
SDK source 0..63
    -> NuttX IRQ 16..79
    -> irq_attach()
    -> callback dispatch
    -> disable/clear/detach lifecycle
```

它本身没有：

- CPU0 SYS 控制寄存器操作
- CPU1/CPU2 启停操作
- AP mailbox 发送逻辑
- CP 外设初始化逻辑
- AP scheduler/IPI 策略

角色差异只存在于“谁选择它”：

```text
CP:
  CONFIG_BK7258_SDK_IRQ_BRIDGE
      -> common/bk7258_sdk_irq.c

AP:
  CONFIG_BK7258_AP_IPI
      -> common/bk7258_sdk_irq.c
      -> ap/bk7258_ap_ipi.c
```

如果拆成两份，会复制最关键的：

- IRQ source 映射
- callback table
- priority 编码
- spinlock/lifecycle 序列化
- unregister/clear/detach 顺序

后续容易出现 CP 修复了竞态、AP 没同步，或者两边 IRQ 优先级语义漂移。因此这里采用：

```text
common bridge + role-specific wrapper
```

更符合最初的 wrapper 分层：

```text
chip/common/bk7258_sdk_irq.c
  通用 SDK IRQ → NuttX IRQ 适配

chip/ap/bk7258_ap_ipi.c
  AP logical CPU0/1 mailbox IPI 策略

chip/cp/...
  CP 外设和 AP lifecycle 控制
```

## 3. 构建入口已同步

已同步修改：

- Classic Make：
  - `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/Make.defs:65`

  - `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/CMakeLists.txt:36`
- Kconfig 说明：
  - `contest2026_135_yongwangzhiqian/board/bk7258_t5ai/chip/Kconfig:176`

Classic Make 仍通过不同 gate 选择同一个 basename；由于 `common/` 已在 VPATH 中，CP 和 AP 都从 common 目录解析该文件。

N8-B2 为正确声明：

```c
crosscore_mb_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t *data)
```

在 `bk7258_sdk_stubs.c` 中引入了：

```c
#include <driver/mailbox_types.h>
```

该 SDK 头文件进一步包含：

```text
mailbox_types.h
  -> common/bk_include.h
  -> components/log.h
  -> components/shell_task.h
```

因此 SDK 的正式声明现在对当前编译单元可见：

```c
int shell_assert_out(bool bContinue, char *format, ...);
```

位置：

历史 stub 却是：

```c

```

返回类型、固定参数数量及 `const` 均不匹配。以前只是因为没有看到 SDK prototype，所以没有在编译阶段暴露。
